extracted text: The aluminogermanate JBW-type zeolite was synthesized from a mixture with the composition: 6 Na2O:3 Rb2O:4.12 Al2O3:8.24 GeO2:202.8 H2O. The synthesis was conducted at 225°C for 5 days under autogenous pressure in a Teflon-lined stainless-steel autoclave. The Al2O3/GeO2 precursor was prepared via a sol-gel route where aluminum nitrate nonahydrate and germanium (IV) oxide were dissolved in dilute nitric acid, precipitated with ammonia solution, dried, and decomposed at 400°C for 4 hours. The resulting product had the formula Na2RbAl3Ge3O12·H2O.
